# RustFrame

> RustFrame is a Rust-powered desktop runtime and CLI for frontend teams building local-first workflow tools with TypeScript or JavaScript, embedded SQLite, consent-scoped file access, and native installers.

RustFrame is an early release candidate. It is deliberately narrower than Tauri or Electron and does not claim a broad native plugin ecosystem. The Rust crates and native release artifacts are public. The rustframe-api npm package is pending its initial 2FA-authorized publication.

## Primary pages

- [Product overview](https://othmaneblial.github.io/rustframe/): Positioning, workflow, security model, flagship proof, comparison, and installation.
- [Documentation](https://othmaneblial.github.io/rustframe/docs.html): Mirrored task guides from the versioned repository source.
- [Showcase](https://othmaneblial.github.io/rustframe/showcase.html): Flagship application, starter, and reference catalog.
- [Research Desk benchmarks](https://othmaneblial.github.io/rustframe/benchmarks.html): Versioned package, native-init, memory, indexing, and warm-build receipts with raw samples and limitations.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/rustframe): Runtime, CLI, frontend bridge, examples, tests, and release workflows.
- [Threat model](https://othmaneblial.github.io/rustframe/docs.html?doc=threat-model): Explicit guarantees, boundaries, and application-author responsibilities.
- [Choosing RustFrame](https://othmaneblial.github.io/rustframe/docs.html?doc=choosing-rustframe): Honest framework comparison and non-goals.
- [Research Desk architecture](https://othmaneblial.github.io/rustframe/docs.html?doc=research-desk-architecture): Flagship behaviors traced to public APIs, permissions, source, and automated tests.

## Stable facts

- License: MIT
- Supported release hosts: macOS, Windows, and Linux
- Default data model: local SQLite with no telemetry by default
- Filesystem model: user-approved opaque grants checked by native IPC
- Manifest schema v1: https://othmaneblial.github.io/rustframe/schemas/v1/rustframe.schema.json
- Current candidate documented by this site: 0.1.0-rc.1
